cuda_cross_compile.instruction_count_scope: Whole kernel including fallback and tail; not dynamic loop count or measured speedup.

execution_scope: SM86 GPU helper/preprocessing execution and CPU script/dispatch/source checks. SM90a attention cross-compiled and linked only; full H200 kernels and FA4 benchmark were not executed locally.
descriptor_scope: Actual CUDA shared addresses at 256 aligned anchor offsets, strides 64/128, fragments 0/32/64/96 bytes, default/nondefault stream. Production offset helper matched the pinned upstream full descriptor construction bitwise. No Hopper MMA execution in this probe.
performance: vc30 unmeasured on H200. vc29 reported about 1.2% slower than vc28; retain vc28 as measured baseline.
